verdict.rationale: The evidence implies that Firstbase itself incorporates companies online: it refers to companies that "did not incorporate with Firstbase" and to creating a Carta cap table one click after incorporation. A community user also reports getting a company up and running in about two weeks, though that was a Wyoming entity. Nothing documents Delaware formation, bylaws, or initial board approvals. Missing for 10: explicit Delaware incorporation support, bylaws generation, initial board consents/approvals, and independent corroboration of an end-to-end Delaware flow.

support.subject: As a founder, I can incorporate a Delaware startup end-to-end online, including the filing, bylaws, and initial board approvals

citations.quote: For non-incorporation (companies that did not incorporate with Firstbase) users can sign up for Loop for free
Our integration with Carta allows you to create a cap table just one click after incorporation.
Used Firstbase, it's cheaper and took me 2 weeks to get up and running.
